FSPLIT.justification: The differentiation of the unified divine call into specific historical actions and suffering.

FFUSE.justification: The gathering of all disparate historical actions back into the unity of the Logos.

EVALF.justification: The negative rejection of the divine form and mission.

phase_3.void_description: The abyss of non-being before the creative act.

steps.domain_action: The soul exists in a state of unformed potentiality before revelation.
The perception of the divine form initiates the theological aesthetic.
The subject recognizes their identity as a creature before the Creator.
The analogy of being establishes the relational bridge between finite and infinite.
The divine mission branches into the active life and the contemplative life.
The active life proceeds through the affirmative Fiat of obedience.
The specific acts of obedience are recorded as permanent historical witnesses.
The contemplative life descends into the kenotic silence of the F-arm.
The soul encounters the reality of sin and the refusal of the light.
The soul enters the Holy Saturday state where death and life are indistinguishable.
The active and contemplative paths reconstitute the unified mission in Christ.
The integrated mission links the creature to the ecclesial body.
The entire sequence is anchored in the finality of the Trinitarian love.
